Imports are previewed and validated before an atomic commit. Ordinary exports are for exchange and viewing; they are not full backups. Start backup and restore in Data transfer; durable progress remains visible in Operations.

Backups are always encrypted. Restore verifies objects, the database, and projections before a non-cancellable safe commit. Deleted transactions remain in Trash for the configured retention period; review effects before restoring or permanently deleting them.

Ledger, attachment, and vault data stays in encrypted local storage unless you explicitly export, back up, or share it. Vault fields never enter ordinary search, logs, telemetry, exports, or widgets. Feature telemetry and crash reporting are off by default and may be withdrawn at any time; turning either off deletes its pending queue and install ID. Retention is documented in Diagnostics and Trash settings. You can obtain your data through export or erase local data after high-risk confirmation.

Widgets read dedicated snapshots only. Quick entry opens a prefilled complete form and never saves directly. App lock, screenshot blocking, and recent-task obscuring are configured in the Security section of Settings.
Notifications show long-running import, export, backup, restore, and recurrence-candidate status. Denial does not block core ledger use, but the system may limit background visibility.
